cases.reason: Component-only queries have no aircraft/JASC context. The adapter records components for metadata/reranker context, while Generic v1 does not use component as a default candidate-ranking bonus.
cases.action: Do not re-enable global component boost. Add context-rich component queries before deciding whether a generic component retrieval role is required.

cases.reason: CHAFED appears only as a condition/symptom and the query lacks aircraft/JASC/part context; the condition is not a dedicated dense retrieval plane in the current adapter role mapping.
cases.action: First test enriched condition queries; only then consider exposing condition as an auxiliary retrieval role.

cases.reason: Repeated low-information condition labels such as FAILED, BROKEN, and MAKING METAL do not uniquely identify a report without aircraft, JASC, component, or part-number context.
cases.action: Keep these as hard ambiguity cases; report them separately from sufficient-query quality.

next_gate: Run an enriched-query sufficiency experiment and a no-router Siemens+Aerospace mixed-domain baseline before changing shared retrieval code.
